Benchmark and dataset provenance

The frozen cases and proposed reference labels were authored by the developer after inspecting the implementation. The family categories differ across the two partitions, but vocabulary and supported grammar overlap. This is not an independent held-out or clinical evaluation.

The benchmark compares the full record history with the same parser and rules applied to only the two latest dated records. Any source issue counts as an abstention. It measures text reconciliation, with no OCR and no simulated human confirmations.

Reference labels and results can influence your judgment. Inspect them after completing your independent review.
